head_proxy_identity.head_source: STEP hole pattern, nozzle end, nominal historical TCP

geometry_sources.joint_body_frames: Seven local STEP meshes driven by nominal standard DH at the actual native solution joints.
geometry_sources.head_cell_state: 15 legacy head component enclosing boxes and nominal supports, bed or printed prism; near or positive clearances are sampled separating-axis lower bounds. A head box contact is a proxy overlap.

scope.native_head_registration: Unknown. For the active TCP the head/cell and head/robot results condition on retaining the unchanged historical CAD registration; physically mounted geometry can differ.
scope.printing: 5 representative perimeters and 3 raster infills; 4 lifts.
scope.entry: Explicit unwrapped joint interpolation, no commanded Cartesian curve. Each candidate starts at the joint vector read on this open station.
scope.local_sigma: Conservative whole-edge standard-DH lower bound. This model also drives the local body CAD.
scope.native_sigma: Independent central difference of native TCP FK at every 25th entry node and every 10th print knot, plus both ends.

joint_encoding: base64, zlib, little-endian float64 rad in row-major order; q_sha256 is SHA256(round(q,12).astype('<f8').tobytes()).
